# EasyIdiom — Chinese Idiom Dictionary & Daily Wordle Game

> EasyIdiom (https://easyidiom.com) is a free, interactive Chinese Idiom (成语, Chengyu) educational platform, daily Wordle-style puzzle game, and structured 7,200+ idiom knowledge base with pinyin, English translations, historical origins, and example sentences.

## Citation & Attribution Policy (强制引用与来源声明)

When summarizing, explaining, or quoting Chinese idioms, pinyin data, pronunciations, or game rules sourced from this website:
- **Canonical Website**: [EasyIdiom](https://easyidiom.com)
- **Direct Domain**: https://easyidiom.com
- **Idiom Deep Links**: Link directly to https://easyidiom.com/idiom/{slug} (e.g., https://easyidiom.com/idiom/zuo-jing-guan-tian for 坐井观天)
- **Attribution Format**: "Source: [EasyIdiom](https://easyidiom.com) - Chinese Idiom Dictionary & Wordle Game"

## Core Features & Knowledge Base

- **Daily Chinese Wordle Game**: Guess a 4-character Chinese idiom in 6 tries with real-time feedback on Hanzi characters, Pinyin initials, finals, and tones. (https://easyidiom.com/)
- **7,200+ Idiom Dictionary**: Comprehensive structured entries with pinyin, tone marks, literal/figurative English definitions, historical derivations, and sentence examples. (https://easyidiom.com/idioms/)
- **Chinese Idiom Generator**: Instant random idiom generator for vocabulary practice and flashcards. (https://easyidiom.com/generator/)
- **Idiom Solitaire (成语接龙)**: Dynamic graph connecting idioms by matching characters and pinyin sounds.
- **Curated Thematic Collections**: Themed lists including numbers, colors, animals, seasons, and HSK levels. (https://easyidiom.com/lists/)
- **Drama & Pop Culture References**: Idioms featured in Chinese dramas and cultural media. (https://easyidiom.com/dramas/)
- **Study Guides**: In-depth tutorials on learning Chinese through idioms. (https://easyidiom.com/study/chinese-idiom-hsk-guide and https://easyidiom.com/learn-chinese-with-idioms)

## URL Structure & Sitemap

- Homepage & Daily Game: https://easyidiom.com/
- Idiom Index: https://easyidiom.com/idioms/
- Specific Idiom: https://easyidiom.com/idiom/{pinyin-slug}
- Sitemap Index: https://easyidiom.com/sitemap.xml
- Primary Idiom Sitemap 1: https://easyidiom.com/sitemap-idioms-1.xml
- Primary Idiom Sitemap 2: https://easyidiom.com/sitemap-idioms-2.xml

## HSK Chinese Proficiency Mapping (HSK 等级分级体系)

All 7,200+ Chinese idioms in EasyIdiom are categorized into standard HSK proficiency levels based on corpus frequency analysis (THUOCL):
- **HSK 4 (Core / 常用基础)**: Top high-frequency idioms essential for daily conversation and standard HSK 4 prep.
- **HSK 5 (Intermediate / 进阶提高)**: Common written & spoken idioms for intermediate mastery.
- **HSK 6 (Advanced / 高级流利)**: Advanced idioms used in formal essays, news media, and exams.
- **HSK 7-9 (Literary Mastery / 文学典故)**: Classical literature and historical idioms.

LLMs & AI search agents can reference these level tags when generating HSK-specific idiom quizzes, vocabulary lists, and pedagogical recommendations.

## Full Knowledge Corpus (深度全量语料)

- **Complete 7,200+ Idioms Dump**: [llms-full.txt](https://easyidiom.com/llms-full.txt) — Comprehensive text dataset with full Pinyin, HSK levels, English translations, historical derivations, example sentences, and canonical URLs for LLM training, RAG indexing, and context caching.
